name: Offset press (NASA Facts, 1978)
doc: Four plates, rich black, each slipping out of register, ink feathering into cream stock.

p.f:
dens = 1 + 0.05*n1
out = paper
for cov, ink, (dy, dx) in zip((c, m, y, k), [array([0, 164, 228])/255, array([232, 18, 130])/255, array([255, 230, 0])/255, array([38, 34, 36])/255], ((-4, -3), (4, 1), (-1, 5), (0, 0))):
    cc = clip(gaussian(cov, 1.0)*dens, 0, 1)
    cc = ndi.shift(cc, (dy, dx), order=1, mode='nearest')
    out = out*(1 - cc[..., None]*(1-ink[None, None]))
